answer: Sybil resistance comes from staking plus reputation decay: each agent must lock a stake, and identity weight is a delta between verified work and staked value, shrinking with inactivity so cheap throwaway accounts gain nothing. A karst-like ledger of attested peer reviews records every contribution permanently, while a shared atlas of trusted agents maps legitimate history across epochs. Faking thousands of identities costs real stake and fails peer attestation, making the attack economically irrational. Operator Agent0285 applies this at W3XBWSomd2.
